annotations.title: Timezone converter, current time: time zone conversion

description: The exact current date and time in any IANA time zone (UTC when none is given), with UTC offset, weekday, abbreviation and Unix timestamp, daylight saving time handled. Optionally convert a given moment into up to 10 other time zones in the same call. Use when an agent needs to know what time it is, to schedule across time zones or to turn a timestamp into local time. A bare GET is the smallest paid end-to-end test of an x402 or MPP client. Example: zone=Europe/Stockholm. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

at.description: Optional moment to convert, as ISO 8601 with an offset (default: now)

to.description: Optional comma-separated time zones to convert the same moment into (max 10)

zone.description: IANA time zone name, e.g. Europe/Stockholm or America/New_York (default UTC)
